Your role and responsibilities As an Application Developer: Cloud Full Stack, you will develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components. You will utilize expertise in multiple layers of application development to deliver efficient and secure cloud-based solutions. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Design and Develop Applications: Develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in No SQL or RDBMS databases. • Apply Dev Ops Methodologies: Apply Dev Ops methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications. • Collaborate on Cloud Environments: Work with senior level practitioners to design, build, and maintain cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools. • Integrate Multiple Technologies: Utilize expertise in multiple layers of application development, including Angular, React, CSS3, HTML5, Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, Groovy, REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and No SQL/RDBMS databases. Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise 5–10 years of software development experience. , 3+ years building scalable backend applications using Java/Springboot and Kotlin. Experience with: Microservices architecture and distributed systems, Event-driven systems and messaging platforms (Kafka). RDBMS (Oracle and Postgres) and No SQL databases (Mongo, Redis, Cassandra) Elasticsearch, Cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP, Azure or similar). Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes or similar). CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Strong problem-solving skills with solid understanding of data structures and algorithms Preferred technical and professional experience • Cloud Security Knowledge: Exposure to cloud security measures, including uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools, is beneficial for this role. • Multi-Technology Integration: Familiarity with integrating multiple technologies, including Angular, React, CSS3, HTML5, Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, Groovy, REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and No SQL/RDBMS databases, is a plus. • Dev Ops Tool Expertise: Exposure to various Dev Ops tools and methodologies to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications is desirable. Years of Experience: 6

You will play a critical role in building, setting up, and maintaining new development tools, infrastructure, and networking. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Provide Technical Support: Deliver 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless operations across various applications, Dev Ops, middleware, security, and infrastructure components. • Develop and Configure Infrastructure: Develop and configure infrastructure and configuration as code using Ansible and Terraform, and administer Dev, Test, and Production environments hosted on Windows, Linux, and Unix servers. • Ensure System Security: Ensure systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats, identify and fix technical problems, and install software updates and fixes. • Manage Cloud Applications: Manage Application ID, provide cloud elasticity by auto-scaling resources based on business requirements, and ensure DR and manual redundancy failover capabilities. • Analyze and Resolve Issues: Identify and resolve issues involving APIs, application services, Iaa S, Paa S, Saa S, microservices, containers, Kubernetes nodes, and infrastructure problems. jobDescription:

Your role and responsibilities As a Data Scientist with Advanced Analytics skills, you will leverage deep data and analytics expertise with strong business acumen to address business challenges. You will utilize data preparation, analysis, and predictive modeling to forecast trends and suggest optimizations for improved business outcomes. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Develop Predictive Models: Utilize mathematical optimization, discrete-event simulation, rules programming, and predictive analytics to forecast trends and suggest optimizations for improved business outcomes. • Analyze Diverse Data Types: Effectively manage and analyze diverse data types and structures, ensuring data-driven decision-making and business optimization. • Implement Data Visualization: Use data visualization tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly to communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders. • Apply Machine Learning Techniques: Apply machine learning, statistical modeling, and custom models to solve business problems in areas like supply chain management, pricing, risk assessment, and fraud detection. • Optimize Business Outcomes: Use optimization tools like IBM CPLEX and Gurobi to identify opportunities for business improvement and implement solutions. Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise • Proficiency in Programming Languages: Exposure to programming languages, particularly Python, and experience working with development environments like Py Charm, VS Code, and Jupyter Notebooks. • Data Manipulation and Analysis: Experience working with data manipulation tools such as Pandas, Num Py, and Dask, and data visualization tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly. • Database Management: Exposure to managing databases like SQL, Mongo DB, Cassandra, Postgre SQL, and My SQL, including scripting abilities in shell scripting. • Optimization and Statistical Analysis: Experience with optimization tools like IBM CPLEX and Gurobi, and statistical analysis capabilities with tools like SPSS, SAS, R, and Python. • Version Control and CI/CD: Exposure to version control systems such as Git, Git Hub, and Git Lab, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) tools like Docker, Podman, and Jenkins. Preferred technical and professional experience • Familiarity with Cloud Platforms: Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and technologies, enabling seamless data integration and scalability. • Knowledge of Big Data Tools: Experience working with big data tools and technologies, such as Hadoop and Spark, to handle large-scale data processing and analysis. • Understanding of Domain-Specific Models: Exposure to domain-specific models and techniques, such as natural language processing and computer vision, to drive business value in specialized areas. Years of Experience: 7

You will work closely with clients to understand their requirements and provide expert guidance on SAP HANA best practices. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Implement SAP HANA Systems: Design and implement SAP HANA systems, including system architecture and data modeling, to meet client requirements and ensure high performance and scalability. • Optimize SAP HANA Landscapes: Configure and optimize SAP HANA landscapes for high performance and scalability, leveraging tools like SAP Data Services or SAP LT for data migration. • Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to gather requirements, provide expert guidance on SAP HANA best practices, and deliver tailored solutions to meet their needs. • Maintain Technical Expertise: Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP HANA features, trends, and best practices, applying this knowledge to optimize system performance and deliver high-quality solutions. • Develop Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise • Exposure to SAP HANA Implementation: Experience working with SAP HANA systems, including design, configuration, and maintenance, with a focus on high availability, scalability, and performance. • SAP HANA Landscape Optimization: Exposure to configuring and optimizing SAP HANA landscapes for high performance and scalability, including data migration using tools like SAP Data Services or SAP LT. • SAP Solution Knowledge: Experience working with various SAP solutions, including S/4 HANA, ECC, BW, SCM, CRM, SRM, HCM, and SQL. • Data Migration and Integration: Exposure to migrating data from various sources to SAP HANA using tools like SAP Data Services or SAP LT. • Technical Documentation Development: Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation and knowledge base to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Preferred technical and professional experience • SAP BTP Knowledge: Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and its integration with SAP HANA systems, including design, configuration, and maintenance. • SLT and SAP ASE Skills: Experience working with SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) and SAP Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE) to support data migration and integration with SAP HANA systems. • Cloud Migration Expertise: Exposure to cloud migration strategies and best practices for SAP HANA systems, including planning, execution, and post-migration optimization. Years of Experience: 7

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Confluent Cloud Infrastructure
jobDescription:
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn,... At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn,... responsibilities About the

ROLE:
Confluent Cloud processes millions of events per second across AWS, GCP, and Azure. When incidents happen in a multi-cloud streaming platform, they happen at scale—data in motion, exactly-once semantics, and cascading failure modes that require deep systems thinking. We need an expert-level engineer who can drive proactive reliability improvements that prevent these incidents before they occur. This role combines hands-on technical work with strategic program ownership. You'll spend roughly 75% of your time on engineering: building automation, improving tooling, analyzing systemic failure patterns, and designing reliability improvements. The remaining 25% is teaching and coordination: coaching teams through post-mortems, training incident commanders, and evolving our incident response practices. You'll be part of a global team with follow-the-sun coverage, with clean handoffs that keep everyone working sustainable hours. Confluent has 800-1000 engineers across highly autonomous teams. This role sits within Cloud Architecture and Reliability
- Supportability (CAR-S), a horizontal team that owns reliability standards and tooling across engineering. You're the person who makes us need incident management less. What You Will Do: Proactive Reliability Engineering (~75% of role) · Analyze systemic failure patterns and design improvements that prevent incident recurrence · Define and maintain SLO/SLA frameworks; use error budgets to guide reliability investments · Build tooling and automation to reduce incident response toil and scale team impact · Own Rootly configuration, workflows, and integrations with Pager Duty, Jira, Confluence, and Slack · Analyze reliability data to identify systemic improvements; build dashboards that drive action · Explore AI-assisted approaches to documentation quality and incident analysis · Design scalable reliability standards that reduce reactive workload over time. Incident Management Program (~25% of role) · Own standards, practices, and continuous improvement of incident response · Serve as an on-call Incident Commander for production incidents, including acting as escalation IC when incidents exceed a team's management chain · Develop and deliver training programs for engineering teams at all levels · Coach teams through post-mortems and on developing actionable corrective actions Customer Root Cause Analysis (CRCA) · Edit and review customer-facing incident documents to ensure quality and clarity · Drive turnaround SLAs while maintaining technical accuracy · Ensure clear explanation of what happened, why, and how we'll prevent recurrence Cross-Team Leadership · Partner with engineering leaders to elevate reliability practices · Be the expert who teams proactively engage for guidance Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise 10+ years in SRE, incident management, or reliability engineering · Cloud experience with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure· Deep expertise with incident management tooling (Rootly, Pager Duty, or similar platforms) Strong understanding of distributed systems and failure modes at scale—Kafka/event streaming expertise preferred, or demonstrated rapid mastery of complex systems Deep experience with observability: metrics, logging, tracing—ability to diagnose complex issues · Kubernetes and container orchestration experience · Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and release processes · Systems thinking: understanding how infrastructure design choices affect failure modes and recovery · Familiarity with SLO/SLA frameworks. Track record as a trusted advisor across engineering organizations · Experience driving org-wide process and cultural changes · Strong written communication (design docs, one-pagers, runbooks) · Post-mortem facilitation experience · Experience with async collaboration across time zones Large company experience navigating reliability/incident programs at 500+ engineer organizations· Preferred technical and professional experience Multi-cloud experience (minimum 2+ of AWS/GCP/Azure). Modern CI/CD, Git Hub, AI-assisted workflows—you'll have the freedom to build what you need. Years of Experience: 10

ROLE:
Confluent Cloud processes millions of events per second across AWS, GCP, and Azure. When incidents happen in a multi-cloud streaming platform, they happen at scale—data in motion, exactly-once semantics, and cascading failure modes that require deep systems thinking. We need an expert-level engineer who can drive proactive reliability improvements that prevent these incidents before they occur. This role combines hands-on technical work with strategic program ownership. You'll spend roughly 75% of your time on engineering: building automation, improving tooling, analyzing systemic failure patterns, and designing reliability improvements. The remaining 25% is teaching and coordination: coaching teams through post-mortems, training incident commanders, and evolving our incident response practices. You'll be part of a global team with follow-the-sun coverage, with clean handoffs that keep everyone working sustainable hours. Confluent has 800-1000 engineers across highly autonomous teams. This role sits within Cloud Architecture and Reliability
- Supportability (CAR-S), a horizontal team that owns reliability standards and tooling across engineering. You're the person who makes us need incident management less. What You Will Do: Proactive Reliability Engineering (~75% of role) · Analyze systemic failure patterns and design improvements that prevent incident recurrence · Define and maintain SLO/SLA frameworks; use error budgets to guide reliability investments · Build tooling and automation to reduce incident response toil and scale team impact · Own Rootly configuration, workflows, and integrations with Pager Duty, Jira, Confluence, and Slack · Analyze reliability data to identify systemic improvements; build dashboards that drive action · Explore AI-assisted approaches to documentation quality and incident analysis · Design scalable reliability standards that reduce reactive workload over time. Incident Management Program (~25% of role) · Own standards, practices, and continuous improvement of incident response · Serve as an on-call Incident Commander for production incidents, including acting as escalation IC when incidents exceed a team's management chain · Develop and deliver training programs for engineering teams at all levels · Coach teams through post-mortems and on developing actionable corrective actions Customer Root Cause Analysis (CRCA) · Edit and review customer-facing incident documents to ensure quality and clarity · Drive turnaround SLAs while maintaining technical accuracy · Ensure clear explanation of what happened, why, and how we'll prevent recurrence Cross-Team Leadership · Partner with engineering leaders to elevate reliability practices · Be the expert who teams proactively engage for guidance Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise 10+ years in SRE, incident management, or reliability engineering · Cloud experience with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure· Deep expertise with incident management tooling (Rootly, Pager Duty, or similar platforms) Strong understanding of distributed systems and failure modes at scale—Kafka/event streaming expertise preferred, or demonstrated rapid mastery of complex systems Deep experience with observability: metrics, logging, tracing—ability to diagnose complex issues · Kubernetes and container orchestration experience · Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and release processes · Systems thinking: understanding how infrastructure design choices affect failure modes and recovery · Familiarity with SLO/SLA frameworks. Track record as a trusted advisor across engineering organizations · Experience driving org-wide process and cultural changes · Strong written communication (design docs, one-pagers, runbooks) · Post-mortem facilitation experience · Experience with async collaboration across time zones Large company experience navigating reliability/incident programs at 500+ engineer organizations· Preferred technical and professional experience Multi-cloud experience (minimum 2+ of AWS/GCP/Azure). A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic... expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology. Your role and responsibilities As an Application Developer: Cloud Full Stack, you will develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components. You will utilize expertise in multiple layers of application development to deliver efficient and secure cloud-based solutions. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Design and Develop Applications: Develop and deploy cloud-based applications using microservices design patterns, integrating front-end, back-end, and middleware components, and persisting data in No SQL or RDBMS databases. • Apply Dev Ops Methodologies: Utilize Dev Ops methodologies and tools to ensure efficient development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications. • Collaborate on Cloud Environments: Work with senior level practitioners to design, build, and maintain cloud environments, focusing on uptime, access, control, and network security using automation and configuration management tools. • Integrate Multiple Technologies: Integrate multiple technologies, including Angular, React, CSS3, HTML5, Java, JEE, Spring, Hibernate, Groovy, REST/SOA services, APIGEE, API Connect, and No SQL/RDBMS databases, to deliver comprehensive cloud-based solutions. Required education Bachelor's Degree Preferred education Master's Degree Required technical and professional expertise Golang, React JS, Java, Join our dynamic team as an experienced Golang Developer and lead the development of high-performance and scalable software solutions using the Go programming language. Your expertise in Go, microservices architecture, and efficient coding practices will be instrumental in creating robust and efficient applications. Preferred technical and professional experience • Cloud Security Knowledge: Exposure to implementing cloud security measures, including network security and access control, to ensure the integrity of cloud-based applications. • Advanced Dev Ops Tools: Experience working with advanced Dev Ops tools and methodologies to optimize the development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications. • Multi-Cloud Environments: Exposure to designing, building, and maintaining multi-cloud environments, focusing on uptime, scalability, and automation. Years of Experience: 6
